title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland Auditorium Arena on 1982-12-31
source: FM Radio Broadcast > Cassete > Wave > Flac

ai_review.summary: A vibrant New Year's Eve third set shines through a gritty yet balanced FM mix that lets Jerry blaze and the horns soar.
ai_review.review: The recording captures a high‑energy NYE show where the third set—featuring the Etta James and Tower of Power horn section, Lovelight and a midnight ring‑in with Sugar Mag—stands out. Listeners praise the mix for its gritty funkiness and better horn balance than other versions, even if it isn’t as crisp as a pure soundboard tape.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers gave 4‑5 stars and highlighted strong performance and an enjoyable, if slightly gritty, mix; the lone low rating is outweighed by overall enthusiasm.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Gritty and funkier than a clean SBD capture; less crisp but offers a balanced horn mix that lets each instrument be heard. Minor imperfections noted, but overall pleasant to the ear.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Solid song selection with sustained energy throughout; third set gets extra kudos for the horn section and special guest moments.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as 'on fire' with sparkling guitar work during the third set.
